name: Fast-Casual Commerce Component Manifest
universalRequirements: touch target of at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels where practical

components.purpose: Maintain brand, branch, fulfilment, menu navigation, account, and cart context.
requiredAccessibility: cart count announced without repeated interruption
components.mobileBehavior: Collapse secondary navigation; keep branch, fulfilment, and cart accessible without covering page headings or browser controls.

components.purpose: Choose delivery, pickup, dine-in, or takeaway when supported.
components.mobileBehavior: Use full-width segmented or stacked controls with no horizontal clipping.

components.purpose: Select and confirm the branch that owns menu, availability, price, hours, and fulfilment.
components.mobileBehavior: Use full-screen dialog or route when the result list is substantial.

components.purpose: Collect and validate an address for delivery eligibility.
components.mobileBehavior: Avoid map-only entry; support software keyboard and safe-area layout.

components.purpose: Communicate store, branch, delivery, pickup, scheduling, or major menu availability status.
components.mobileBehavior: Wrap cleanly and never push the primary action offscreen without a way to continue.

components.purpose: Move through menu categories while preserving selection and scroll context.
requiredAccessibility: navigation or tab semantics as appropriate
components.mobileBehavior: Allow touch scrolling without hiding the selected item; use scroll padding for sticky headers.

components.purpose: Present one menu item with enough information to decide, add, or customise.
components.mobileBehavior: Do not rely on hover. Preserve readable price and action with long names.

components.purpose: Show base, starting, option-adjusted, discounted, fee, tax, and total values without ambiguity.
components.mobileBehavior: Prevent truncation of large values and localised currency formats.

components.purpose: Communicate product, option, branch, or service availability concisely.
components.mobileBehavior: Wrap or abbreviate only when meaning remains clear.

components.purpose: Collect one required or optional choice group such as size, base, crust, or preparation.
components.mobileBehavior: Use a single readable column when labels or descriptions are long.

components.purpose: Select optional additions or removals with price and availability feedback.
components.mobileBehavior: Use list or two-column layout only when each target remains large and labels do not truncate.

components.purpose: Change quantity within verified limits.
components.mobileBehavior: Use large touch targets and prevent accidental double activation.

components.purpose: Compose product identity, option groups, modifiers, quantity, price, validation, and add action.
components.mobileBehavior: Use a full-screen route or sheet with a safe-area-aware action bar and no hidden final options.

components.purpose: Show cart item count, total, conflicts, and route to cart review.
components.mobileBehavior: May be fixed only when it respects safe areas, zoom, keyboard, and page content.

components.purpose: Provide fast cart review without losing menu context when the product and viewport support it.
components.mobileBehavior: Use full-height drawer or route; never make checkout depend on a narrow side panel.

components.purpose: Show configured product, unit price, quantity, line total, and edit or removal actions.
components.mobileBehavior: Stack metadata and actions without separating them from the affected item.

components.purpose: Present subtotal, discounts, fees, tax, loyalty, and total with qualification or recalculation messages.
components.mobileBehavior: Remain readable at high zoom and with large currency values.

components.purpose: Apply and remove verified promotion codes without disrupting the cart.
components.mobileBehavior: Keep input and action usable without horizontal squeeze.

components.purpose: Show a verified promotion, qualification, and direct path to eligible products or cart application.
components.mobileBehavior: Keep benefit and critical conditions visible without relying on hover.

components.purpose: Show verified balance, earning, redemption, expiry, and activity.
components.mobileBehavior: Prioritise balance and usable value before history.

components.purpose: Group one checkout stage or section with completion and error status.
components.mobileBehavior: Avoid several nested accordions; keep failed sections expanded.

components.purpose: Choose and safely submit a supported payment method.
components.mobileBehavior: Support external payment return and preserve checkout context.

components.purpose: Present verified order states and the current position without inventing progress.
components.mobileBehavior: Use a vertical timeline; avoid horizontal overflow.
